description.zh: 把 Excel / CSV 数据变成结论：数据画像和质量检查（缺失、重复、异常值、写法不一致），分组汇总、同比环比、占比排名，生成带 Excel 原生图表的汇总表，再写结论先行、数字有出处的分析报告并导出 Word。
description.en: Turns Excel/CSV data into conclusions: profiling and quality checks, grouped summaries with period-over-period and share analysis, Excel workbooks with native charts, and conclusion-first reports exported to Word.

welcome_message.zh: 把 Excel 或 CSV 发给我，告诉我想回答什么问题
welcome_message.en: Send me an Excel or CSV file and the question you want answered

prompt.zh: 我上传了 ___，先帮我检查一下数据质量，告诉我有哪些问题。
prompt.en: I uploaded ___. Check the data quality first and tell me what's wrong.

prompt.zh: 分析 ___ 按 ___（月/季度）的变化趋势，计算环比和同比，并做成图表。
prompt.en: Analyze how ___ changes by ___ (month/quarter) with growth rates and a chart.

prompt.zh: 按 ___ 汇总 ___，看各自占比和排名，前 ___ 名之外合并为其他。
prompt.en: Summarize ___ by ___ with share and ranking; group everything beyond the top ___ as Other.

prompt.zh: ___ 指标在 ___ 下滑了，帮我拆解是哪些维度带来的，并列出可能原因。
prompt.en: ___ dropped in ___. Break down which segments drove it and list possible causes.

prompt.zh: 根据这份数据写一份 ___ 分析报告，汇报对象是 ___，重点回答：___。
prompt.en: Write a ___ analysis report from this data for ___, answering: ___.

prompt.zh: 做一个 ___ × ___ 的交叉汇总，指标是 ___，并配一张柱形图。
prompt.en: Build a ___ × ___ cross-tab of ___ with a column chart.

zh: 每周一「09:30」读取 inbound 目录的最新销售表，生成上周销售简报
每月 3 日「10:00」汇总上月数据，生成月度经营分析报告初稿
每天「08:30」检查新上传的数据文件，输出数据质量体检结果
每季度第一个工作日「10:00」生成上季度同比环比分析和图表
每周五「16:00」更新 Top 10 客户排名，标出排名变化
每月 1 日「09:00」对比上月目标完成率，列出未达标的项目
en: Every Monday at 09:30, read the latest sales file in inbound and draft last week's brief
On the 3rd of each month at 10:00, compile last month's data into a business review draft
Every day at 08:30, run a quality check on newly uploaded data files
On the first weekday of each quarter at 10:00, build last quarter's growth analysis and charts
Every Friday at 16:00, update the top-10 customer ranking and flag changes
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, compare last month's results with targets and list misses
